scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ai-flow/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @ai-flow/contracts" "npm run dev -w @ai-flow/api" "npm run dev -w @ai-flow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-flow/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-flow/api && npm run build -w @ai-flow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ai-flow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
